exposure: Levobupivacaine and Buprenorphine in TAP block
Levobupivacaine and Dexamethasone in TAP block
outcome: time to first rescue analgesic requirement
cohort: 52 women aged 20-40 years old undergoing cesarean delivery
finding: Women who received Levobupivacaine and Buprenorphine in a TAP block after cesarean delivery had longer time to first rescue analgesic requirement and lower total tramadol consumption in the first 24 hours compared to women who received Levobupivacaine and Dexamethasone.
